'''Glow berries''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is '''Aura''': a few seconds after eating one of their dishes, every other creature within 50 blocks starts glowing, so it can be seen through walls. Eaten raw, glow berries heal {{Hp|1}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/glow_berries.json}}</ref> The developer suggests them for caving.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If they're caving, they should probably grab some glow berries or carrots.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Harvesting ===
Cave vines give and drop the pack's glow berries.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/harvest/cave_vine.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating glow berries heals {{Hp|1}}.

Picking up glow berries unlocks [[Glow Berry Mash|glow berry mash]]. They can also replace sweet berries in [[mead]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Behavior ==
=== Aura ===
Aura isn't a status effect. Eating [[Glow Berry Mash|glow berry mash]], [[Glow Berry Jam|glow berry jam]] or [[Glow Berry Crumble|glow berry crumble]] triggers an advancement that plays a resonating bell sound and, 2.4 seconds later, gives {{MCW|Glowing}} to every entity within 50 blocks of the player, excluding the player, for 3 seconds, 30 seconds or 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_effect_30.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_apply_glow_30.mcfunction}}</ref> The functions are named after [[soul sight]].
